name: Chang'e 4
ephemeris: JPL Horizons, airless apparent azimuth/elevation, 10-minute steps; model in source headers

science.frameEvidence: LROC's PDS catalogue of human-made objects (ANTHROPOGENIC_OBJECTS, updated 2026-08-14, method of Wagner et al. 2017) lists this lander at -45.4562, 177.5886, 4 m from our point, from an LROC NAC terrain model; LROC gives its coordinates in the mean Earth/polar axis (ME) system with DE421 (LROC 2016 coordinate table; LROC RDR SIS section 5.5).
